title: LightCRS: Lightweight Multi-Domain Conversational Recommendation System
authors: He Ma, Lan You, Qiyang Wu, Chen Liu

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26948）：LightCRS 处理的是一个常见的两难——'deploying a separately adapted VLM per domain scales cost linearly with the number of domains and requires routing each dialogue to the right model, while naively merging all domains into a single VLM degrades accuracy'。解法把重活推到离线：'precomputes multimodal product representations once offline with frozen encoders'，在线只留一个 'compact 5.3M-parameter module' 做 'query-conditioned cross-attention'（参数跨域共享），再用 'inter-candidate Transformer' 联合比较候选。数字为作者自述：'LightCRS achieves state-of-the-art average HR@1, NDCG@5, and MRR, improving HR@1 by 35.4% over the strongest baseline while reducing per-query latency by 266 times'；另有一条反直觉的对照——'Joint multi-domain training itself improves HR@1 by 15.2% over separately trained single-domain models'，即合并训练比单域模型更好，与开头的 'naively merging degrades accuracy' 形成对照，说明关键不是合不合而是合的方式。benchmark 是作者自建的 MM-R2A-25（'a 25-domain benchmark pairing natural Reddit recommendation-seeking conversations with Amazon product listings'）。价值路由：可迁移的不是推荐，而是 '离线冻结编码 + 在线 5.3M 参数 query-conditioned 融合' 这个成本结构——凡是我们面对 '多域 × 多模态 × 在线延迟敏感' 的场景（如多租户工具集、多套 schema 的结构化输出解析）都能套。证据边界：266 倍延迟降低是相对最强基线的自述口径，基线的 serving 配置摘要未说明，无第三方复现。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：待核验/暂无。
